newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil telecom ratings maintained.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brazil telecom ratings maintained.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said it was maintaining its buy recommendations on Brazilian telecoms Telebras, Telesp and Telemig and its hold rating on Telerj and Telepar.
-- "We are maintaining our recommendations on all the teles we cover..., although at the same time we are reducing our net income forecasts for 1997," the brokerage said in a report.
-- It said Brazil's telecommunications market has been hit by a series of changes in recent months, including new B Band cellular regulations and a proposed General Telecommunications Law, it said.
-- Fator said stocks also will be affected by postponement of a rate rebalancing to 1997's second quarter, a lower late payment fine and a new labor contract.

-- Payment by some firms of anticipated deferred income tax, drop in cellular tariffs, provisions for voluntary resignations and new inflation, interest and exchange rate estimates also will influence stock prices, it said.
-- The brokerage said it lowered its 1997 net profit forecast for Telebras to 3.936 billion reais from 4.341 billion reais.
-- It said Telebras' earnings forecast was reduced "due to postponement of tariff rebalancing, collective labor agreement, compensatory bonus and reduction in fines for late payment," Fator said.
-- Fator also said it reduced its 1997 forecast for Telesp to 1.294 billion reais from 1.188 billion reais and for Telemig to 398.3 million reais from 446.4 million reais.
-- It said it reduced its estimate for Telerj's 1997 net profit to 240.4 million from 297 million reais and its forecast for Telepar TO 187.1 million reais from 206.1 million reais.
-- Telesp, Telemig, Telerj and Telepar are subsidiaries of federal holding Telebras, which is slated to be broken up and sold off starting this year.
